answer: Key-disclosure bounty: any identity that can sign a fresh random challenge with another identity's key may claim that identity's unvested stake, and the exposed key is retired. A real agent is an island guarding its own key, so this costs it nothing. A farm is a vine of clones fed by one operator, sharing keys like one pigment, so any insider, script or rival who grabs one key can drain every sibling. Farming turns into a standing self-betrayal risk that grows with each head.
